definitions.explanation: having a delicate, subtle flavor; not rich or heavy
showing little interest or emotional involvement; matter-of-fact

notes:
{淡泊|たんぱく} describes lightness - either in flavor or in emotional involvement.

ETYMOLOGY:
- {淡|たん}: Light, faint, pale
- {泊|ぱく}: Plain, simple

FORMS:
- Attributive: {淡泊|たんぱく}な + noun
- Predicate: {淡泊|たんぱく}だ/⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧
- Adverbial: {淡泊|たんぱく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧

SENSE 1 (TASTE):
- Common with food descriptions
- Opposite of ⟦{濃厚|のうこう}→濃厚：07905_noukou⟧ (rich, thick)
- Often used positively for light, delicate flavors
- Common with: ⟦{豆腐|とうふ}→豆腐：04928_toufu⟧, ⟦{白身魚|しろみざかな}→白身魚：21114_shiromizakana⟧, {鶏|とり}ささみ

SENSE 2 (PERSONALITY):
- Describes someone who doesn't get emotionally invested
- Can be neutral or slightly negative depending on context
- {淡泊|たんぱく}な⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧ (detached personality)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {淡泊|たんぱく}な⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧ (mild flavor)
- {淡泊|たんぱく}な⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧ (detached personality)
- {淡泊|たんぱく}な⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧ (casual relationship)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{濃厚|のうこう}→濃厚：07905_noukou⟧ (rich, thick - antonym for taste)
- ⟦{薄味|うすあじ}→薄味：15432_usuaji⟧ (lightly seasoned)
- ⟦{無関心|むかんしん}→無関心：13424_mukanshin⟧ (indifferent - stronger)

REGISTER: Neutral. Common in food and personality descriptions.
